Magnet / Horde.name: Special Magnet
Magnet / Horde.description: Attracts ALL specials to any alive target with this troll enabled

Magnet / Horde.name: Tank Magnet
Magnet / Horde.description: Attracts ALL tanks to any alive target with this troll enabled

Magnet / Horde.name: Witch Magnet
Magnet / Horde.description: All witches when startled will target any player with this troll

Magnet / Horde.name: Swarm
Magnet / Horde.description: Swarms a player with zombies. Requires swarm plugin

Magnet / Horde.name: Vomit Player
Magnet / Horde.description: Shortcut to sm_vomitplayer. vomits the player.

Items.name: Throw It All
Items.description: Player throws their item(s) periodically to a nearby player

Items.name: Bad Throw
Items.description: Player drops throwables on throw, and biles/molotovs themselves

Items.name: No Pickup
Items.description: Prevents a player from picking up ANY (new) item. Use ThrowItAll to make them drop

Items.name: UziRules
Items.description: Picking up a weapon gives them a UZI instead

Items.name: Primary Disable
Items.description: Player cannot pickup any weapons, only melee/pistols

Items.name: Half Primary Ammo
Items.description: Cuts their primary reserve ammo in half

Chat.name: iCantSpellNoMore
Chat.description: Chat messages letter will randomly changed with wrong letters

Chat.name: No Profanity
Chat.description: Replaces some words with random phrases

Chat.name: Vocalize Gag
Chat.description: Prevents player from sending any vocalizations (even automatic)

Health.name: Damage Boost
Health.description: Makes a player take more damage than normal

Health.name: Temp Health Quick Drain
Health.description: Makes a player's temporarily health drain very quickly

Health.name: Slow Drain
Health.description: Will make the player slowly lose health over time

Health.name: KillMeSoftly
Health.description: Make player eat or waste pills whenever possible

Misc.name: Gun Jam
Misc.description: On reload, small chance their gun gets jammed - Can't reload.

Misc.name: Slow Speed
Misc.description: Sets player speed to 0.8x of normal speed

Misc.name: Higher Gravity
Misc.description: Sets player gravity to 1.3x of normal gravity

Misc.name: CameTooEarly
Misc.description: When they shoot, random chance they empty whole clip
